name: Lagoon Suite
description: A sweeping suite perched above the lagoon with floor-to-ceiling glass walls and a private infinity plunge pool. Wakes of coral light drift through the mornings.

name: Forest Villa
description: Nestled among century-old trees, this villa offers a sanctuary where birdsong replaces alarm clocks. Stone floors and warm timber beams create an earthen elegance.

name: Garden Pavilion
tagline: Bloom in your own private world
description: Surrounded by curated tropical gardens, the Garden Pavilion opens entirely to the outdoors. Designed for couples who want space to breathe and silence to think.
